correctness.rationale: The classical Lagrange-inversion profile enumeration n!/((n+1-k)!prod m_j!) implies ordered block sizes conditional on K=k are uniform positive compositions of n into k parts. Counting prescribed first/second parts gives E S1=k(k-1)/(n-1), E Sr=k*binom(n-r-1,k-2)/binom(n-1,k-1), and E S1Sr=k(k-1)*binom(n-r-2,k-3)/binom(n-1,k-1). Their covariance factors as positive multiplier k(k-1)p/((n-1)(n-r-1)) times (rk-2(n-1)), with explicit r=n-1 and boundary cases. The all-n unconditional covariance is negative via the exact positive-square certificate 4(n+1)Delta=(2(n+1)r-7n+5)^2+16(n-3)^3+87(n-3)^2+144(n-3)+64 for n>=3, n=2 checked directly. Typical K~n/2 gives opposing order-n limits. Independently enumerated all noncrossing partitions n<=6, and expanded polynomial certificate symbolically.
